sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Print Digital Solutions Inc is a printing equipment and supplies distributor with over 40 years of expertise since 1984, offering digital printing equipment, finishing equipment, and consumables.

Industry: Equipment & Supplies · HQ: Toronto, ON, Canada · Size: not published · Products: Label Printers, Label Finishers, Digital Cutting Systems, Die Cutters, Paper Cutters, Folders

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Print Digital Solutions Inc scores 17 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (8/15). Nothing was found for application fit and company size, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (32% similar on printing, label, digital, print); Drytac (18% similar on print, printing, films, graphic); ORAFOL Europe (15% similar on printing, digital, films, graphic). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
